cutout_prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Only remove the background from this user-approved finished character illustration for the game's UI. The input is the sole edit target and identity authority. Deliver an actual transparent RGBA PNG, preserving the original 1024x1536 canvas, character placement, scale, pose, head/face/eyes, warm skin, silver short hair, purple double-horn headpiece, newly approved continuous navy sleeveless tunic, red waist sash, black pants, white gloves, ivory fur cloak, black boots, giant blue-silver gauntlet and cyan flame. Preserve the exact approved outfit: no hanging waist rings, straps or streamers may reappear.
Remove only the pale grey backdrop and ground/contact shadow, including background gaps between the horns, arms, legs, cloak and flame. Keep the white hair and white cloak opaque, with clean antialiased edges. Retain the existing flame's cyan colors and appropriate edge transparency. Preserve all visible ink lines, colors, shading and existing shapes as closely as possible. No redesign, new pose, resizing, recentering, recoloring, new lighting, edge glow or extra shadow. No painted checkerboard; genuine alpha transparency. Return only the same isolated finished figure.
